sources.primary_title: HUMAIN and MinIO Announce Strategic Partnership to Build AI Data Fabric
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, HUMAIN (a PIF company) and MinIO announced a strategic partnership to co-develop HUMAIN Fabric, an AI-native data platform. MinIO becomes HUMAIN's data and memory foundation partner, providing high-performance object storage and persistent memory for the HUMAIN AI Stack (including HUMAIN Brain and HUMAIN One). The collaboration focuses on building sovereign, AI-native data infrastructure capable of supporting autonomous AI agents at an enterprise scale. The partnership will begin with deployments in Saudi Arabia before expanding globally. This angle is distinct from general HUMAIN Chat announcements, focusing specifically on the foundational data infrastructure and the strategic B2B partnership with MinIO.
